summary_en: BASE disclosed an amendment to the tender offer by SBINM LLC for all outstanding shares. The offer period was extended to October 15, 2026 (30 business days total). The company's largest shareholder resumed stock purchases targeting over 30% ownership on October 2, 2026, citing restrictions on free trading during the offer and disagreement with management over conditions for operational support.
title_en: Notice of Amendment Regarding Support for Public Tender Offer for Shares by SBINM LLC (wholly owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings Inc.) and Expression of Neutral Opinion, as well as Execution of Capital and Business Alliance Agreement with SBI Holdings Inc.
translation_en_brief:
BASE, Inc. published an amendment notice to its previously disclosed tender offer opinion regarding SBINM LLC's public tender offer for all outstanding shares of the company. This amendment adds information about material developments following the original disclosure on August 28, 2026, and the first amendment on September 30, 2026.

The offer period has been extended to October 15, 2026, comprising 30 business days in total, as decided by the public tender offeror on September 30, 2026. BASE's board of directors has confirmed its support for the tender offer and its neutral position on whether shareholders should tender. On September 30, the company notified its largest shareholder of the period extension and provided written responses regarding potential operational support and the shareholder's trading constraints.

On October 1, BASE received notice that the largest shareholder, citing disagreements with management over the treatment of trading restrictions linked to operational support conditions, has decided to resume purchasing BASE shares starting October 2, 2026, with the aim of raising its ownership stake to exceed 30%. BASE stated that it considered the shareholder's potential disadvantages but noted differing positions have emerged between the company and the largest shareholder regarding these matters.
